title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Oil (WTI) +12% since 20:00 UTC yesterday → $102.59; Brent ~$108 — Iran IRGC targeted 2 US Navy vessels + 8 oil tankers in Strait of Hormuz.
Houthis seized key Yemen port overnight; WTI eyeing $105; supply shock deepening.
FOMC Sep 16 (5 days out) — hike odds 60–65%; CPI Aug due 13:30 UTC today, consensus 3.4% YoY.
